reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5334, book 68, باب تُحِدُّ الْمُتَوَفَّى عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ ابْنَةِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّهَا أَخْبَرَتْهُ هَذِهِ الأَحَادِيثَ الثَّلاَثَةَ، قَالَتْ زَيْنَبُ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى أُمِّ حَبِيبَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ تُوُفِّيَ أَبُوهَا أَبُو سُفْيَانَ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، فَدَعَتْ أُمُّ حَبِيبَةَ بِطِيبٍ فِيهِ صُفْرَةٌ خَلُوقٌ أَوْ غَيْرُهُ فَدَهَنَتْ مِنْهُ جَارِيَةً، ثُمَّ مَسَّتْ بِعَارِضَيْهَا، ثُمَّ قَالَتْ وَاللَّهِ مَا لِي بِالطِّيبِ مِنْ حَاجَةٍ، غَيْرَ أَنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ يَحِلُّ لاِمْرَأَةٍ تُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ أَنْ تُحِدَّ عَلَى مَيِّتٍ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثِ لَيَالٍ، إِلاَّ عَلَى زَوْجٍ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: ‘Abd Allah ibn Yusuf narrated to us: Malik informed us, from ‘Abd Allah ibn Abi Bakr ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Amr ibn Hazm, from Humayd ibn Nafi‘, from Zaynab bint Abi Salamah, who informed him of these three reports. Zaynab said: I visited Umm Habibah, the wife of the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, when her father Abu Sufyan ibn Harb died. Umm Habibah called for perfume containing yellow khaluq or something else, applied some to a servant girl, and then touched her own cheeks with it. She said, ‘By Allah, I have no need for perfume, except that I heard the Messenger of Allah say, “It is not lawful for a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to mourn for a dead person for more than three nights, except for her husband: four months and ten days.”’

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5335, book 68, باب تُحِدُّ الْمُتَوَفَّى عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا
text_original: قَالَتْ زَيْنَبُ فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَى زَيْنَبَ ابْنَةِ جَحْشٍ حِينَ تُوُفِّيَ أَخُوهَا، فَدَعَتْ بِطِيبٍ فَمَسَّتْ مِنْهُ، ثُمَّ قَالَتْ أَمَا وَاللَّهِ مَا لِي بِالطِّيبِ مِنْ حَاجَةٍ غَيْرَ أَنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ ‏"‏ لاَ يَحِلُّ لاِمْرَأَةٍ تُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ أَنْ تُحِدَّ عَلَى مَيِّتٍ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثِ لَيَالٍ إِلاَّ عَلَى زَوْجٍ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Zaynab said: I visited Zaynab bint Jahsh when her brother died. She called for perfume and applied some of it. Then she said, ‘By Allah, I have no need for perfume, except that I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, say from the pulpit, “It is not lawful for a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to mourn for a dead person for more than three nights, except for her husband: four months and ten days.”’

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5336, book 68, باب تُحِدُّ الْمُتَوَفَّى عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا
text_original: قَالَتْ زَيْنَبُ وَسَمِعْتُ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ، تَقُولُ جَاءَتِ امْرَأَةٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ ابْنَتِي تُوُفِّيَ عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا وَقَدِ اشْتَكَتْ عَيْنَهَا أَفَتَكْحُلُهَا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏‏.‏ مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا كُلَّ ذَلِكَ يَقُولُ لاَ، ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا هِيَ أَرْبَعَةُ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرٌ، وَقَدْ كَانَتْ إِحْدَاكُنَّ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ تَرْمِي بِالْبَعَرَةِ عَلَى رَأْسِ الْحَوْلِ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Zaynab said: I heard Umm Salamah say: A woman came to the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, and said, ‘Messenger of Allah, my daughter’s husband has died, and her eyes are troubling her. May she use kohl?’ The Messenger of Allah said, ‘No.’ She asked two or three times, and each time he said, ‘No.’ Then the Messenger of Allah said, ‘It is only four months and ten days. In the pre-Islamic period, one of you would throw a piece of dung at the end of a year.’

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5337, book 68, باب تُحِدُّ الْمُتَوَفَّى عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا
text_original: قَالَ حُمَيْدٌ فَقُلْتُ لِزَيْنَبَ وَمَا تَرْمِي بِالْبَعَرَةِ عَلَى رَأْسِ الْحَوْلِ فَقَالَتْ زَيْنَبُ كَانَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ إِذَا تُوُفِّيَ عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا دَخَلَتْ حِفْشًا، وَلَبِسَتْ شَرَّ ثِيَابِهَا، وَلَمْ تَمَسَّ طِيبًا حَتَّى تَمُرَّ بِهَا سَنَةٌ، ثُمَّ تُؤْتَى بِدَابَّةٍ حِمَارٍ أَوْ شَاةٍ أَوْ طَائِرٍ فَتَفْتَضُّ بِهِ، فَقَلَّمَا تَفْتَضُّ بِشَىْءٍ إِلاَّ مَاتَ، ثُمَّ تَخْرُجُ فَتُعْطَى بَعَرَةً فَتَرْمِي، ثُمَّ تُرَاجِعُ بَعْدُ مَا شَاءَتْ مِنْ طِيبٍ أَوْ غَيْرِهِ‏.‏ سُئِلَ مَالِكٌ مَا تَفْتَضُّ بِهِ قَالَ تَمْسَحُ بِهِ جِلْدَهَا‏.‏
en_text: Humayd said: I asked Zaynab, ‘What does it mean that she threw a piece of dung at the end of a year?’ Zaynab said: When a woman’s husband died, she would enter a small, cramped hut, wear her worst clothes, and use no perfume until a year had passed. Then a donkey, sheep, or bird would be brought to her, and she would rub herself with it. Scarcely would she rub herself with anything without it dying. Then she would come out and be given a piece of dung to throw, after which she could use whatever perfume or other things she wished. Malik was asked what ‘rub herself with it’ meant. He said, ‘She would rub it on her skin.’

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5338, book 68, باب الْكُحْلِ لِلْحَادَّةِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ بْنُ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ ابْنَةِ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّهَا، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، تُوُفِّيَ زَوْجُهَا فَخَشُوا عَلَى عَيْنَيْهَا فَأَتَوْا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاسْتَأْذَنُوهُ فِي الْكُحْلِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تَكَحَّلْ قَدْ كَانَتْ إِحْدَاكُنَّ تَمْكُثُ فِي شَرِّ أَحْلاَسِهَا أَوْ شَرِّ بَيْتِهَا، فَإِذَا كَانَ حَوْلٌ فَمَرَّ كَلْبٌ رَمَتْ بِبَعَرَةٍ، فَلاَ حَتَّى تَمْضِيَ أَرْبَعَةُ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرٌ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Adam ibn Abi Iyas narrated to us: Shu‘bah narrated to us: Humayd ibn Nafi‘ narrated to us, from Zaynab bint Umm Salamah, from her mother, that a woman’s husband died and they feared for her eyes. They came to the Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, and asked permission for her to use kohl. He said, ‘No. One of you used to stay in the worst of her homes or huts, and when a year had passed and a dog went by, she would throw a piece of dung. No, she must wait until four months and ten days have passed.’

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5339, book 68, باب الْكُحْلِ لِلْحَادَّةِ
text_original: وَسَمِعْتُ زَيْنَبَ ابْنَةَ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، تُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أُمِّ حَبِيبَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ يَحِلُّ لاِمْرَأَةٍ مُسْلِمَةٍ تُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ أَنْ تُحِدَّ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامٍ، إِلاَّ عَلَى زَوْجِهَا أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: I heard Zaynab bint Umm Salamah narrate from Umm Habibah that the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said, ‘It is not lawful for a Muslim woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to mourn for more than three days, except for her husband: four months and ten days.’

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5340, book 68, باب الْكُحْلِ لِلْحَادَّةِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلَمَةُ بْنُ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَتْ أُمُّ عَطِيَّةَ نُهِينَا أَنْ نُحِدَّ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ثَلاَثٍ إِلاَّ بِزَوْجٍ‏.‏
en_text: Musaddad narrated to us: Bishr narrated to us: Salamah ibn ‘Alqamah narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Sirin, who said: Umm ‘Atiyyah said: We were forbidden to mourn for a dead person for more than three days, except for a husband.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5341, book 68, باب الْقُسْطِ لِلْحَادَّةِ عِنْدَ الطُّهْرِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَهَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ، قَالَتْ كُنَّا نُنْهَى أَنْ نُحِدَّ عَلَى مَيِّتٍ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثٍ، إِلاَّ عَلَى زَوْجٍ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا، وَلاَ نَكْتَحِلَ، وَلاَ نَطَّيَّبَ، وَلاَ نَلْبَسَ ثَوْبًا مَصْبُوغًا، إِلاَّ ثَوْبَ عَصْبٍ، وَقَدْ رُخِّصَ لَنَا عِنْدَ الطُّهْرِ إِذَا اغْتَسَلَتْ إِحْدَانَا مِنْ مَحِيضِهَا فِي نُبْذَةٍ مِنْ كُسْتِ أَظْفَارٍ، وَكُنَّا نُنْهَى عَنِ اتِّبَاعِ الْجَنَائِزِ‏.‏
en_text: ‘Abd Allah ibn ‘Abd al-Wahhab narrated to me: Hammad ibn Zayd narrated to us, from Ayyub, from Hafsah, from Umm ‘Atiyyah, who said: We were forbidden to mourn for a dead person for more than three days, except for a husband: four months and ten days. We were also forbidden to use kohl, perfume, and dyed clothing, except a garment dyed with ‘asb. We were permitted, at the end of our menstrual period after one of us had bathed, to use a small amount of kust and azfar. We were forbidden to follow funeral processions.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5342, book 68, باب تَلْبَسُ الْحَادَّةُ ثِيَابَ الْعَصْبِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ دُكَيْنٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ السَّلاَمِ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّ عَطِيَّةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ يَحِلُّ لاِمْرَأَةٍ تُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ أَنْ تُحِدَّ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثٍ، إِلاَّ عَلَى زَوْجٍ، فَإِنَّهَا لاَ تَكْتَحِلُ وَلاَ تَلْبَسُ ثَوْبًا مَصْبُوغًا إِلاَّ ثَوْبَ عَصْبٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Al-Fadl ibn Dukayn narrated to us: ‘Abd al-Salam ibn Harb narrated to us, from Hisham, from Hafsah, from Umm ‘Atiyyah, who said: The Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, said, ‘It is not lawful for a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to mourn for more than three days, except for her husband. She must not use kohl or wear dyed clothing, except a garment dyed with ‘asb.’

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5343, book 68, باب تَلْبَسُ الْحَادَّةُ ثِيَابَ الْعَصْبِ
text_original: وَقَالَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، حَدَّثَتْنَا حَفْصَةُ، حَدَّثَتْنِي أُمُّ عَطِيَّةَ، نَهَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَلاَ تَمَسَّ طِيبًا إِلاَّ أَدْنَى طُهْرِهَا إِذَا طَهُرَتْ، نُبْذَةً مِنْ قُسْطٍ وَأَظْفَارٍ ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْد اللَّهِ الْقُسْطُ وَالْكُسْتُ مِثْلُ الْكَافُورِ وَالْقَافُورِ
en_text: Al-Ansari said: Hisham narrated to us: Hafsah narrated to us: Umm ‘Atiyyah narrated to me that the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, forbade her to use perfume, except a little kust and azfar at the end of her period when she had become pure. Abu ‘Abd Allah said: Kust is like kafur, and azfar is like kafur.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5344, book 68, بَابُ: {وَالَّذِينَ يُتَوَفَّوْنَ مِنْكُمْ وَيَذَرُونَ أَزْوَاجًا} إِلَى قَوْلِهِ: {بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شِبْلٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، ‏[quran sura="2" aya_start="234" aya_end="234"]{‏وَالَّذِينَ يُتَوَفَّوْنَ مِنْكُمْ وَيَذَرُونَ أَزْوَاجًا‏}‏ قَالَ كَانَتْ هَذِهِ الْعِدَّةُ تَعْتَدُّ عِنْدَ أَهْلِ زَوْجِهَا وَاجِبًا، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏[quran sura="2" aya_start="240" aya_end="240"]{‏وَالَّذِينَ يُتَوَفَّوْنَ مِنْكُمْ وَيَذَرُونَ أَزْوَاجًا وَصِيَّةً لأَزْوَاجِهِمْ مَتَاعًا إِلَى الْحَوْلِ غَيْرَ إِخْرَاجٍ فَإِنْ خَرَجْنَ فَلاَ جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِيمَا فَعَلْنَ فِي أَنْفُسِهِنَّ مِنْ مَعْرُوفٍ‏}‏ قَالَ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لَهَا تَمَامَ السَّنَةِ سَبْعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعِشْرِينَ لَيْلَةً وَصِيَّةً إِنْ شَاءَتْ سَكَنَتْ فِي وَصِيَّتِهَا، وَإِنْ شَاءَتْ خَرَجَتْ، وَهْوَ قَوْلُ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏[quran sura="2" aya_start="240" aya_end="240"]{‏غَيْرَ إِخْرَاجٍ فَإِنْ خَرَجْنَ فَلاَ جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ‏}‏ فَالْعِدَّةُ كَمَا هِيَ، وَاجِبٌ عَلَيْهَا، زَعَمَ ذَلِكَ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَطَاءٌ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ نَسَخَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ عِدَّتَهَا عِنْدَ أَهْلِهَا، فَتَعْتَدُّ حَيْثُ شَاءَتْ، وَقَوْلُ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى ‏[quran sura="2" aya_start="240" aya_end="240"]{‏غَيْرَ إِخْرَاجٍ‏}‏‏.‏ وَقَالَ عَطَاءٌ إِنْ شَاءَتِ اعْتَدَّتْ عِنْدَ أَهْلِهَا، وَسَكَنَتْ فِي وَصِيَّتِهَا، وَإِنْ شَاءَتْ خَرَجَتْ لِقَوْلِ اللَّهِ ‏[quran sura="2" aya_start="240" aya_end="240"]{‏فَلاَ جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِيمَا فَعَلْنَ‏}‏‏.‏ قَالَ عَطَاءٌ ثُمَّ جَاءَ الْمِيرَاثُ فَنَسَخَ السُّكْنَى، فَتَعْتَدُّ حَيْثُ شَاءَتْ، وَلاَ سُكْنَى لَهَا‏.‏
en_text: Ishaq ibn Mansur narrated to me: Rawh ibn ‘Ubadah informed us: Shibl narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, concerning the verse, ‘Those among you who die and leave wives…’ (2:234). He said: A widow was required to observe her waiting period at her husband’s family’s home. Then Allah revealed, ‘Those among you who die and leave wives: a bequest for their wives of maintenance for a year without expelling them. If they leave, there is no blame upon you for what they do with themselves in a fair manner’ (2:240). Allah made a full year for her: seven months and 27 nights as a bequest. If she wished, she could remain in the home provided for her; if she wished, she could leave. That is what Allah means by, ‘without expelling them. If they leave, there is no blame upon you.’ The waiting period remains as it is, and it is obligatory for her. Mujahid held this view. ‘Ata’ said that Ibn ‘Abbas said: This verse abrogated the requirement that she observe her waiting period at her husband’s family’s home; she could observe it wherever she wished. This is what Allah means by, ‘without expelling them.’ ‘Ata’ said: If she wished, she could observe her waiting period at her husband’s family’s home and live in the home bequeathed to her; if she wished, she could leave, because Allah said, ‘There is no blame upon you for what they do.’ ‘Ata’ said: Then the inheritance ruling came and abrogated the right to housing. She could observe her waiting period wherever she wished, and she had no right to housing.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5345, book 68, بَابُ: {وَالَّذِينَ يُتَوَفَّوْنَ مِنْكُمْ وَيَذَرُونَ أَزْوَاجًا} إِلَى قَوْلِهِ: {بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ}
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ، حَدَّثَنِي حُمَيْدُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ ابْنَةِ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّ حَبِيبَةَ ابْنَةِ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، لَمَّا جَاءَهَا نَعِيُّ أَبِيهَا دَعَتْ بِطِيبٍ، فَمَسَحَتْ ذِرَاعَيْهَا وَقَالَتْ مَا لِي بِالطِّيبِ مِنْ حَاجَةٍ‏.‏ لَوْلاَ أَنِّي سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ يَحِلُّ لاِمْرَأَةٍ تُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ تُحِدُّ عَلَى مَيِّتٍ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثٍ، إِلاَّ عَلَى زَوْجٍ أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْهُرٍ وَعَشْرًا ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Kathir narrated to us, from Sufyan, from ‘Abd Allah ibn Abi Bakr ibn ‘Amr ibn Hazm. Humayd ibn Nafi‘ narrated to me, from Zaynab bint Umm Salamah, from Umm Habibah bint Abi Sufyan: When news of her father’s death reached her, she called for perfume, rubbed it on her forearms, and said, ‘I have no need for perfume. Were it not that I heard the Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, say, “It is not lawful for a woman who believes in Allah and the Last Day to mourn for a dead person for more than three days, except for her husband: four months and ten days,” I would not have used it.’

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5346, book 68, باب مَهْرِ الْبَغِيِّ وَالنِّكَاحِ الْفَاسِدِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ نَهَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ ثَمَنِ الْكَلْبِ، وَحُلْوَانِ الْكَاهِنِ، وَمَهْرِ الْبَغِيِّ‏.‏
en_text: ‘Ali ibn ‘Abd Allah narrated to us: Sufyan narrated to us, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Bakr ibn ‘Abd al-Rahman, from Abu Mas‘ud, may Allah be pleased with him, who said: The Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, forbade the price of a dog, the payment received by a soothsayer, and the bride-price earned by a prostitute.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5347, book 68, باب مَهْرِ الْبَغِيِّ وَالنِّكَاحِ الْفَاسِدِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَوْنُ بْنُ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ لَعَنَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْوَاشِمَةَ، وَالْمُسْتَوْشِمَةَ، وَآكِلَ الرِّبَا وَمُوكِلَهُ، وَنَهَى عَنْ ثَمَنِ الْكَلْبِ، وَكَسْبِ الْبَغِيِّ، وَلَعَنَ الْمُصَوِّرِينَ‏.‏
en_text: Adam narrated to us: Shu‘bah narrated to us: ‘Awn ibn Abi Juhaifah narrated to us, from his father, who said: The Prophet, peace and blessings of Allah be upon him, cursed the woman who tattoos and the woman who has herself tattooed, those who consume usury and those who pay it, forbade the price of a dog and the earnings of a prostitute, and cursed image-makers.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5349, book 68, باب الْمَهْرِ لِلْمَدْخُولِ عَلَيْهَا
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ زُرَارَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لاِبْنِ عُمَرَ رَجُلٌ قَذَفَ امْرَأَتَهُ فَقَالَ فَرَّقَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ أَخَوَىْ بَنِي الْعَجْلاَنِ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّ أَحَدَكُمَا كَاذِبٌ، فَهَلْ مِنْكُمَا تَائِبٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَبَيَا، فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّ أَحَدَكُمَا كَاذِبٌ، فَهَلْ مِنْكُمَا تَائِبٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ فَأَبَيَا، فَفَرَّقَ بَيْنَهُمَا‏.‏ قَالَ أَيُّوبُ فَقَالَ لِي عَمْرُو بْنُ دِينَارٍ فِي الْحَدِيثِ شَىْءٌ لاَ أَرَاكَ تُحَدِّثُهُ قَالَ قَالَ الرَّجُلُ مَالِي‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ مَالَ لَكَ، إِنْ كُنْتَ صَادِقًا فَقَدْ دَخَلْتَ بِهَا، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ كَاذِبًا فَهْوَ أَبْعَدُ مِنْكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Narrated Sa'id bin Jubair: I said to Ibn 'Umar, 'A man accused his wife of adultery.' He replied, 'The Prophet (ﷺ) separated the two people of Banu 'Ajlan and said, "Allah knows that one of you is lying. Will either of you repent?" They both refused. He repeated, "Allah knows that one of you is lying. Will either of you repent?" They both refused, so he separated them.' Ayyub said: 'Amr bin Dinar told me something in the hadith that I do not see you narrating. He said that the man asked, "What about my property?" The Prophet said, "You have no claim to it. If you spoke the truth, you had intercourse with her; and if you lied, then it is even farther from you."'

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5350, book 68, باب الْمُتْعَةِ لِلَّتِي لَمْ يُفْرَضْ لَهَا
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لِلْمُتَلاَعِنَيْنِ ‏"‏ حِسَابُكُمَا عَلَى اللَّهِ، أَحَدُكُمَا كَاذِبٌ، لاَ سَبِيلَ لَكَ عَلَيْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَالِي‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ مَالَ لَكَ، إِنْ كُنْتَ صَدَقْتَ عَلَيْهَا، فَهْوَ بِمَا اسْتَحْلَلْتَ مِنْ فَرْجِهَا، وَإِنْ كُنْتَ كَذَبْتَ عَلَيْهَا، فَذَاكَ أَبْعَدُ وَأَبْعَدُ لَكَ مِنْهَا ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Narrated Ibn 'Umar: The Prophet (ﷺ) said to the two who had invoked the curse: 'Your reckoning is with Allah. One of you is lying, and you have no right to her.' The man said, 'O Messenger of Allah, what about my property?' He replied, 'You have no claim to it. If you spoke truthfully about her, it was in return for what you made lawful of her; but if you lied about her, then it is even farther from you.'

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5351, book 69, باب فَضْلِ النَّفَقَةِ عَلَى الأَهْلِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا آدَمُ بْنُ أَبِي إِيَاسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ يَزِيدَ الأَنْصَارِيَّ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، فَقُلْتُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ فَقَالَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا أَنْفَقَ الْمُسْلِمُ نَفَقَةً عَلَى أَهْلِهِ وَهْوَ يَحْتَسِبُهَا، كَانَتْ لَهُ صَدَقَةً ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Narrated Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, 'When a Muslim spends on his family seeking reward for it, that spending is charity for him.' This means that a person is rewarded for providing for his household when he does so seeking Allah's reward.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5352, book 69, باب فَضْلِ النَّفَقَةِ عَلَى الأَهْلِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ أَنْفِقْ يَا ابْنَ آدَمَ أُنْفِقْ عَلَيْكَ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Narrated Abu Huraira: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, 'Allah says: Spend, O son of Adam, and I will spend on you.' This is a promise that Allah will provide for the one who spends in His cause.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5353, book 69, باب فَضْلِ النَّفَقَةِ عَلَى الأَهْلِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ قَزَعَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ ثَوْرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْغَيْثِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ السَّاعِي عَلَى الأَرْمَلَةِ وَالْمِسْكِينِ كَالْمُجَاهِدِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ، أَوِ الْقَائِمِ اللَّيْلَ الصَّائِمِ النَّهَارَ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'The one who strives to support a widow and a poor person is like one who fights in the way of Allah, or like one who prays throughout the night and fasts during the day.'

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5354, book 69, باب فَضْلِ النَّفَقَةِ عَلَى الأَهْلِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ سَعْد ٍ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَعُودُنِي وَأَنَا مَرِيضٌ بِمَكَّةَ، فَقُلْتُ لِي مَالٌ أُوصِي بِمَالِي كُلِّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ فَالشَّطْرُ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏‏.‏ قُلْتُ فَالثُّلُثُ قَالَ ‏"‏ الثُّلُثُ، وَالثُّلُثُ كَثِيرٌ، أَنْ تَدَعَ وَرَثَتَكَ أَغْنِيَاءَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَنْ تَدَعَهُمْ عَالَةً، يَتَكَفَّفُونَ النَّاسَ فِي أَيْدِيهِمْ، وَمَهْمَا أَنْفَقْتَ فَهُوَ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ حَتَّى اللُّقْمَةَ تَرْفَعُهَا فِي فِي امْرَأَتِكَ، وَلَعَلَّ اللَّهَ يَرْفَعُكَ، يَنْتَفِعُ بِكَ نَاسٌ وَيُضَرُّ بِكَ آخَرُونَ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Narrated Sa'd: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to visit me when I was ill in Mecca. I said, 'I have wealth. May I bequeath all of it?' He said, 'No.' I asked, 'Half?' He said, 'No.' I asked, 'One third?' He said, 'One third, and one third is much. It is better to leave your heirs wealthy than to leave them dependent, begging people with their hands. Whatever you spend is charity for you, even the morsel you place in your wife's mouth. Perhaps Allah will raise you in rank, and some people will benefit through you while others will be harmed by you.'

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5355, book 69, باب وُجُوبِ النَّفَقَةِ عَلَى الأَهْلِ وَالْعِيَالِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَالِحٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَفْضَلُ الصَّدَقَةِ مَا تَرَكَ غِنًى، وَالْيَدُ الْعُلْيَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْيَدِ السُّفْلَى، وَابْدَأْ بِمَنْ تَعُولُ ‏"‏‏.‏ تَقُولُ الْمَرْأَةُ إِمَّا أَنْ تُطْعِمَنِي وَإِمَّا أَنْ تُطَلِّقَنِي‏.‏ وَيَقُولُ الْعَبْدُ أَطْعِمْنِي وَاسْتَعْمِلْنِي‏.‏ وَيَقُولُ الاِبْنُ أَطْعِمْنِي، إِلَى مَنْ تَدَعُنِي فَقَالُوا يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ سَمِعْتَ هَذَا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ هَذَا مِنْ كِيسِ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ‏.‏
en_text: Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, 'The best charity is what leaves a person self-sufficient, and the upper hand is better than the lower hand. Begin with those for whom you are responsible.' The wife says, 'Either you feed me or divorce me.' The slave says, 'Feed me and employ me.' The son says, 'Feed me; to whom will you leave me?' They asked Abu Huraira, 'Did you hear this from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)?' He said, 'No. This is from Abu Huraira's own store.'

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5356, book 69, باب وُجُوبِ النَّفَقَةِ عَلَى الأَهْلِ وَالْعِيَالِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عُفَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ خَالِدِ بْنِ مُسَافِرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ خَيْرُ الصَّدَقَةِ مَا كَانَ عَنْ ظَهْرِ غِنًى، وَابْدَأْ بِمَنْ تَعُولُ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Narrated Abu Huraira: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, 'The best charity is that given from what remains after one's needs are met, and begin with those for whom you are responsible.' That is, a person should first provide for the dependants whose care is his responsibility.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5357, book 69, باب حَبْسِ نَفَقَةِ الرَّجُلِ قُوتَ سَنَةٍ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ، وَكَيْفَ نَفَقَاتُ الْعِيَالِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلاَمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي مَعْمَرٌ قَالَ لِي الثَّوْرِيُّ هَلْ سَمِعْتَ فِي الرَّجُلِ يَجْمَعُ لأَهْلِهِ قُوتَ سَنَتِهِمْ أَوْ بَعْضِ السَّنَةِ قَالَ مَعْمَرٌ فَلَمْ يَحْضُرْنِي، ثُمَّ ذَكَرْتُ حَدِيثًا حَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ الزُّهْرِيُّ عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَوْسٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَبِيعُ نَخْلَ بَنِي النَّضِيرِ، وَيَحْبِسُ لأَهْلِهِ قُوتَ سَنَتِهِمْ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad bin Salam narrated to me: Waki' informed us, from Ibn 'Uyayna, who said: Ma'mar said to me that al-Thawri asked him, 'Have you heard anything about a man setting aside his family's provision for a year, or for part of a year?' Ma'mar said, 'I could not recall anything at the time.' Later I remembered a hadith that Ibn Shihab al-Zuhri narrated to us, from Malik bin Aws, from 'Umar: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to sell the date palms of Banu al-Nadir and reserve his family's provision for a year.'

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5358, book 69, باب حَبْسِ نَفَقَةِ الرَّجُلِ قُوتَ سَنَةٍ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ، وَكَيْفَ نَفَقَاتُ الْعِيَالِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عُفَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي اللَّيْثُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَوْسِ بْنِ الْحَدَثَانِ، وَكَانَ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ ذَكَرَ لِي ذِكْرًا مِنْ حَدِيثِهِ، فَانْطَلَقْتُ حَتَّى دَخَلْتُ عَلَى مَالِكِ بْنِ أَوْسٍ فَسَأَلْتُهُ فَقَالَ مَالِكٌ انْطَلَقْتُ حَتَّى أَدْخُلَ عَلَى عُمَرَ، إِذْ أَتَاهُ حَاجِبُهُ يَرْفَا فَقَالَ هَلْ لَكَ فِي عُثْمَانَ وَعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ وَالزُّبَيْرِ وَسَعْدٍ يَسْتَأْذِنُونَ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَأَذِنَ لَهُمْ ـ قَالَ ـ فَدَخَلُوا وَسَلَّمُوا فَجَلَسُوا، ثُمَّ لَبِثَ يَرْفَا قَلِيلاً فَقَالَ لِعُمَرَ هَلْ لَكَ فِي عَلِيٍّ وَعَبَّاسٍ قَالَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ فَأَذِنَ لَهُمَا، فَلَمَّا دَخَلاَ سَلَّمَا وَجَلَسَا، فَقَالَ عَبَّاسٌ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ اقْضِ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ هَذَا‏.‏ فَقَالَ الرَّهْطُ عُثْمَانُ وَأَصْحَابُهُ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ اقْضِ بَيْنَهُمَا، وَأَرِحْ أَحَدَهُمَا مِنَ الآخَرِ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ اتَّئِدُوا أَنْشُدُكُمْ بِاللَّهِ الَّذِي بِهِ تَقُومُ السَّمَاءُ وَالأَرْضُ، هَلْ تَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ نُورَثُ مَا تَرَكْنَا صَدَقَةٌ ‏"‏‏.‏ يُرِيدُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَفْسَهُ‏.‏ قَالَ الرَّهْطُ قَدْ قَالَ ذَلِكَ‏.‏ فَأَقْبَلَ عُمَرُ عَلَى عَلِيٍّ وَعَبَّاسٍ فَقَالَ أَنْشُدُكُمَا بِاللَّهِ هَلْ تَعْلَمَانِ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ذَلِكَ قَالاَ قَدْ قَالَ ذَلِكَ‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ فَإِنِّي أُحَدِّثُكُمْ عَنْ هَذَا الأَمْرِ، إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ خَصَّ رَسُولَهُ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي هَذَا الْمَالِ بِشَىْءٍ لَمْ يُعْطِهِ أَحَدًا غَيْرَهُ، قَالَ اللَّهُ ‏[quran sura="59" aya_start="6" aya_end="6"]{‏مَا أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ مِنْهُمْ فَمَا أَوْجَفْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ خَيْلٍ‏}‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏قَدِيرٌ‏}‏‏.‏ فَكَانَتْ هَذِهِ خَالِصَةً لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَاللَّهِ مَا احْتَازَهَا دُونَكُمْ وَلاَ اسْتَأْثَرَ بِهَا عَلَيْكُمْ، لَقَدْ أَعْطَاكُمُوهَا وَبَثَّهَا فِيكُمْ، حَتَّى بَقِيَ مِنْهَا هَذَا الْمَالُ، فَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُنْفِقُ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ نَفَقَةَ سَنَتِهِمْ مِنْ هَذَا الْمَالِ، ثُمَّ يَأْخُذُ مَا بَقِيَ، فَيَجْعَلُهُ مَجْعَلَ مَالِ اللَّهِ، فَعَمِلَ بِذَلِكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَيَاتَهُ، أَنْشُدُكُمْ بِاللَّهِ، هَلْ تَعْلَمُونَ ذَلِكَ قَالُوا نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ لِعَلِيٍّ وَعَبَّاسٍ أَنْشُدُكُمَا بِاللَّهِ هَلْ تَعْلَمَانِ ذَلِكَ قَالاَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ ثُمَّ تَوَفَّى اللَّهُ نَبِيَّهُ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ أَنَا وَلِيُّ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَبَضَهَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ يَعْمَلُ فِيهَا بِمَا عَمِلَ بِهِ فِيهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنْتُمَا حِينَئِذٍ ـ وَأَقْبَلَ عَلَى عَلِيٍّ وَعَبَّاسٍ ـ تَزْعُمَانِ أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ كَذَا وَكَذَا، وَاللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُ فِيهَا صَادِقٌ بَارٌّ رَاشِدٌ تَابِعٌ لِلْحَقِّ، ثُمَّ تَوَفَّى اللَّهُ أَبَا بَكْرٍ فَقُلْتُ أَنَا وَلِيُّ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبِي بَكْرٍ، فَقَبَضْتُهَا سَنَتَيْنِ أَعْمَلُ فِيهَا بِمَا عَمِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ، ثُمَّ جِئْتُمَانِي وَكَلِمَتُكُمَا وَاحِدَةٌ وَأَمْرُكُمَا جَمِيعٌ، جِئْتَنِي تَسْأَلُنِي نَصِيبَكَ مِنِ ابْنِ أَخِيكَ، وَأَتَى هَذَا يَسْأَلُنِي نَصِيبَ امْرَأَتِهِ مِنْ أَبِيهَا، فَقُلْتُ إِنْ شِئْتُمَا دَفَعْتُهُ إِلَيْكُمَا عَلَى أَنَّ عَلَيْكُمَا عَهْدَ اللَّهِ وَمِيثَاقَهُ لَتَعْمَلاَنِ فِيهَا بِمَا عَمِلَ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَبِمَا عَمِلَ بِهِ فِيهَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، وَبِمَا عَمِلْتُ بِهِ فِيهَا، مُنْذُ وُلِّيتُهَا، وَإِلاَّ فَلاَ تُكَلِّمَانِي فِيهَا فَقُلْتُمَا ادْفَعْهَا إِلَيْنَا بِذَلِكَ‏.‏ فَدَفَعْتُهَا إِلَيْكُمَا بِذَلِكَ، أَنْشُدُكُمْ بِاللَّهِ هَلْ دَفَعْتُهَا إِلَيْهِمَا بِذَلِكَ فَقَالَ الرَّهْطُ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَقْبَلَ عَلَى عَلِيٍّ وَعَبَّاسٍ فَقَالَ أَنْشُدُكُمَا بِاللَّهِ هَلْ دَفَعْتُهَا إِلَيْكُمَا بِذَلِكَ قَالاَ نَعَمْ‏.‏ قَالَ أَفَتَلْتَمِسَانِ مِنِّي قَضَاءً غَيْرَ ذَلِكَ، فَوَالَّذِي بِإِذْنِهِ تَقُومُ السَّمَاءُ وَالأَرْضُ لاَ أَقْضِي فِيهَا قَضَاءً غَيْرَ ذَلِكَ، حَتَّى تَقُومَ السَّاعَةُ، فَإِنْ عَجَزْتُمَا عَنْهَا فَادْفَعَاهَا فَأَنَا أَكْفِيكُمَاهَا‏.‏
en_text:
Sa'id bin 'Ufair narrated that al-Layth told him, from 'Uqayl, from Ibn Shihab: Malik bin Aws bin al-Hadathan informed me. Muhammad bin Jubair bin Mut'im had mentioned to me something from his account, so I went and met Malik bin Aws and asked him about it. Malik said:

I went to see 'Umar. His doorkeeper, Yarfa', came and said, 'Will you receive 'Uthman, 'Abd al-Rahman, al-Zubair, and Sa'd? They are asking permission to enter.' 'Umar said, 'Yes,' and admitted them. They entered, greeted him, and sat down. After a short while Yarfa' came again and said, 'Will you receive 'Ali and al-'Abbas?' 'Umar said, 'Yes,' and admitted them. They entered, greeted him, and sat down. Al-'Abbas said, 'Commander of the Faithful, judge between me and this man.' 'Uthman and his companions said, 'Commander of the Faithful, judge between them and relieve one of them of the other.'

'Umar said, 'Wait. I adjure you by Allah, by whose command the heavens and earth stand: do you know that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "We are not inherited from; whatever we leave is charity"? He meant himself.' They replied, 'He did say that.' 'Umar turned to 'Ali and al-'Abbas and said, 'I adjure you by Allah: do you both know that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said that?' They replied, 'He did say that.'

'Umar continued, 'I will explain this matter to you. Allah granted His Messenger a special share of this property that He granted to no one else. Allah said: "Whatever Allah restored to His Messenger from them, you did not spur horses or camels for it" (Quran 59:6), and continued to the words, "and Allah is capable of all things." This was exclusively for the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). By Allah, he did not take it for himself to the exclusion of you, nor did he keep it for himself instead of you. He gave it to you and distributed it among you, until this property remained. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to provide his family's yearly maintenance from it, then take what remained and put it toward the public treasury. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) followed this practice throughout his life. I adjure you by Allah: do you know this?' They said, 'Yes.' He said to 'Ali and al-'Abbas, 'I adjure you by Allah: do you both know this?' They said, 'Yes.'

Then Allah took His Prophet's life, and Abu Bakr said, 'I am the guardian of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ).' Abu Bakr took charge of it and managed it as the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had managed it. At that time, you—turning to 'Ali and al-'Abbas—claimed that Abu Bakr had done such-and-such. Allah knows that he was truthful, dutiful, rightly guided, and following the truth in this matter.

Then Allah took Abu Bakr's life, and I said, 'I am the guardian of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and of Abu Bakr.' I took charge of it for two years and managed it as the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and Abu Bakr had done. Then both of you came to me, united in what you said and in your purpose: you came asking me for your share from your nephew, and this one came asking me for his wife's share from her father. I said, 'If you wish, I will hand it over to you on the condition that you pledge before Allah to manage it as the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did, as Abu Bakr did, and as I have done since I took charge of it. Otherwise, do not bring this matter to me.' You both said, 'Hand it over to us on that condition,' so I handed it over to you on that condition. I adjure you by Allah: did I hand it over to them on that condition?' The group replied, 'Yes.'

'Umar then turned to 'Ali and al-'Abbas and said, 'I adjure you by Allah: did I hand it over to you on that condition?' They said, 'Yes.' He said, 'Are you now asking me to judge it differently? By the One by whose command the heavens and earth stand, I will never judge this matter differently until the Last Hour comes. If you cannot manage it, then return it to me, and I will take care of it for you.'

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5359, book 69, باب نَفَقَةِ الْمَرْأَةِ إِذَا غَابَ عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا وَنَفَقَةِ الْوَلَدِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مُقَاتِلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ قَالَتْ جَاءَتْ هِنْدُ بِنْتُ عُتْبَةَ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ أَبَا سُفْيَانَ رَجُلٌ مِسِّيكٌ، فَهَلْ عَلَىَّ حَرَجٌ أَنْ أُطْعِمَ مِنَ الَّذِي لَهُ عِيَالَنَا قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ إِلاَّ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Hind bint Utbah came and said, O Messenger of Allah, Abu Sufyan is a miserly man. Is there any blame on me if I feed our children from what belongs to him? He replied, No, except according to what is fair. Aishah reported Hind's question and the Prophet's reply about giving the family what was fair.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5360, book 69, باب نَفَقَةِ الْمَرْأَةِ إِذَا غَابَ عَنْهَا زَوْجُهَا وَنَفَقَةِ الْوَلَدِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ هَمَّامٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ـ رضى الله عنه ـ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا أَنْفَقَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ مِنْ كَسْبِ زَوْجِهَا عَنْ غَيْرِ أَمْرِهِ فَلَهُ نِصْفُ أَجْرِهِ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Abu Huraira reported that the Prophet said, If a woman spends from her husband's earnings without his instruction, she receives half of his reward. Abu Huraira related this statement from the Prophet about a wife's spending from her husband's earnings.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5361, book 69, باب عَمَلِ الْمَرْأَةِ فِي بَيْتِ زَوْجِهَا
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي الْحَكَمُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، أَنَّ فَاطِمَةَ ـ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ ـ أَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَشْكُو إِلَيْهِ مَا تَلْقَى فِي يَدِهَا مِنَ الرَّحَى، وَبَلَغَهَا أَنَّهُ جَاءَهُ رَقِيقٌ فَلَمْ تُصَادِفْهُ، فَذَكَرَتْ ذَلِكَ لِعَائِشَةَ، فَلَمَّا جَاءَ أَخْبَرَتْهُ عَائِشَةُ ـ قَالَ ـ فَجَاءَنَا وَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا مَضَاجِعَنَا، فَذَهَبْنَا نَقُومُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ عَلَى مَكَانِكُمَا ‏"‏‏.‏ فَجَاءَ فَقَعَدَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهَا حَتَّى وَجَدْتُ بَرْدَ قَدَمَيْهِ عَلَى بَطْنِي فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَلاَ أَدُلُّكُمَا عَلَى خَيْرٍ مِمَّا سَأَلْتُمَا، إِذَا أَخَذْتُمَا مَضَاجِعَكُمَا ـ أَوْ أَوَيْتُمَا إِلَى فِرَاشِكُمَا ـ فَسَبِّحَا ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ، وَاحْمَدَا ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ، وَكَبِّرَا أَرْبَعًا وَثَلاَثِينَ، فَهْوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمَا مِنْ خَادِمٍ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Ali reported that Fatimah came to the Prophet complaining of pain in her hand from grinding. She had heard servants had been brought to him but did not find him, so she told Aishah. When he came, Aishah informed him. He came to us while we had gone to bed. We started to get up, but he said, Stay where you are. He sat between us until I felt the coolness of his feet on my stomach. He said, Shall I tell you something better than what you asked for? When you go to bed, glorify Allah thirty-three times, praise Allah thirty-three times, and declare Allah's greatness thirty-four times. That is better for you than a servant.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5362, book 69, باب خَادِمِ الْمَرْأَةِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُمَيْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي يَزِيدَ، سَمِعَ مُجَاهِدًا، سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ أَبِي لَيْلَى، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، أَنَّ فَاطِمَةَ ـ عَلَيْهَا السَّلاَمُ ـ أَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَسْأَلُهُ خَادِمًا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَلاَ أُخْبِرُكِ مَا هُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكِ مِنْهُ، تُسَبِّحِينَ اللَّهَ عِنْدَ مَنَامِكِ ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ، وَتَحْمَدِينَ اللَّهَ ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ، وَتُكَبِّرِينَ اللَّهَ أَرْبَعًا وَثَلاَثِينَ ‏"‏‏.‏ ـ ثُمَّ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ إِحْدَاهُنَّ أَرْبَعٌ وَثَلاَثُونَ ـ فَمَا تَرَكْتُهَا بَعْدُ، قِيلَ وَلاَ لَيْلَةَ صِفِّينَ قَالَ وَلاَ لَيْلَةَ صِفِّينَ‏.‏
en_text: Fatimah came to the Prophet asking him for a servant. He said, Shall I tell you something better for you? Glorify Allah thirty-three times when you go to sleep, praise Allah thirty-three times, and declare Allah's greatness thirty-four times. Sufyan added that one of these should be said thirty-four times. Ali said, I have not stopped doing this since. He was asked, Not even on the night of Siffin? He replied, Not even on the night of Siffin.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5363, book 69, باب خِدْمَةِ الرَّجُلِ فِي أَهْلِهِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَرْعَرَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ عُتَيْبَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ ـ رضى الله عنها ـ مَا كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَصْنَعُ فِي الْبَيْتِ قَالَتْ كَانَ فِي مِهْنَةِ أَهْلِهِ، فَإِذَا سَمِعَ الأَذَانَ خَرَجَ‏.‏
en_text: Al-Aswad bin Yazid asked Aishah what the Prophet used to do at home. She said, He would serve his family, and when he heard the call to prayer, he would go out. This is Aishah's description of his conduct with his household before he left for prayer.

reference: Sahih al-Bukhari, hadith 5364, book 69, باب إِذَا لَمْ يُنْفِقِ الرَّجُلُ فَلِلْمَرْأَةِ أَنْ تَأْخُذَ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمِهِ مَا يَكْفِيهَا وَوَلَدَهَا بِالْمَعْرُوفِ
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ هِنْدَ بِنْتَ عُتْبَةَ، قَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ أَبَا سُفْيَانَ رَجُلٌ شَحِيحٌ، وَلَيْسَ يُعْطِينِي مَا يَكْفِينِي وَوَلَدِي، إِلاَّ مَا أَخَذْتُ مِنْهُ وَهْوَ لاَ يَعْلَمُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ خُذِي مَا يَكْفِيكِ وَوَلَدَكِ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ ‏"‏‏.‏
en_text: Hind bint Utbah said, O Messenger of Allah, Abu Sufyan is stingy and does not give me enough for myself and my children unless I take from his property without his knowledge. Is there any blame on me? He said, Take what is enough for you and your children, according to what is fair.
